virtual_knobs.controls: A..H page-function encoders; native index I is the separate Level/Data control
virtual_knobs.absolute_sync: removed after the native integrator proved a two-frame -127/target sequence cannot establish an absolute endpoint
virtual_knobs.subsequent_motion: host movement is sent as a signed 8-bit delta
virtual_knobs.readback: SYN, SMP, FLTR, AMP, and LFO values refresh from the stock 42-word Q8 bank exported at 0x8000E5B0

runtime_proof.probe: signed -127 followed by +64; transport-only, not an absolute-value claim
runtime_proof.visible_change_attribution: not a proven parameter mutation; paired RAM snapshots changed only continuously moving state

decision: QWERTY controls traverse the native button event path. Mouse A..H controls traverse the native encoder event, integrator, setter, and Q8 mutation path. Frontend numbers now come from firmware state rather than an unsynchronized host counter.

next_gate.name: AR172_QEMU_TRIG_AND_LEVEL_READBACK_GATE
next_gate.objective: Map the separate TRIG-page owner and encoder-I Level/Data state.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: Untouched stock firmware ran locally. No firmware, project data, factory sample names, or proprietary PCM are included.
